messages:
maya: Quick draft of safe-experimentation guardrails for model variant rollouts. Need quick eyes on acceptance criteria, rollback rules, and pinning semantics.
serena: nice. list the required telemetry first — we need metrics that catch both perf and semantic quality.
eli: telemetry suggestion: p50_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, token_cost_per_response, request_error_rate, semantic_regression_score (embed-distance on test set), human_eval_failure_rate. propose thresholds: p95 <= baseline*1.2, error_rate_delta <= +0.5%, semantic_regression_abs <= 0.02.
tom: pinning question: some customers want strict session pins. what granularity are we supporting?
maya: plan: three pin types—ephemeral session pin (cookie/token, TTL default 7d), tenant pin (sticky until revoke or TTL 30d), and explicit user pin for experimental opt-ins. Dedicated/Private should allow tenant-admin override.
harper: automated rollback triggers (draft):
```
rollback_on:
  - name: p95_latency
    trigger: > baseline * 1.25
    window: 30m
  - name: error_rate
    trigger: > baseline + 1%
    window: 15m
  - name: semantic_regression
    trigger: > 0.03
    window: 24h
  - name: infra_errors
    trigger: >= 3 errors
    window: 10m
```
ops-bot: note: when candidate traffic >= 20% autoscaler may allocate burst nodes; events posted to #eng-runtime. we'll emit deploy events.
serena: edge cases: per-prompt regressions. we need per-prompt-set deltas and automated sampling for human review if a prompt family shows >0.015 drift.
eli: tenancy safeguards: auto-exclude top-5 revenue tenants unless they opt-in. block experiments during customer migrations. require customer notification for tenant-level pins.
tom: experiment schedule + stats: what's the phased ramp and required sample sizes for semantic checks?
harper: suggested ramp: 24h @2% -> 48h @10% -> 72h @30% -> ramp to 100%. For quality: use bootstrap CIs, require p<0.05 and min_effect_size 0.01 plus min_samples 1k per variant per route. safety gate: stop on any rollback rule.
maya: acceptance criteria to proceed past 30%:
- metrics live in Console (per-variant, per-tenant, per-route)
- rollback automation wired to deploy engine and on-call
- pre-rollout evals on canonical + tenant golden prompts
- runbook + customer comms templates
- tenant opt-out and pin override UI available
eli: special-case: if candidate reduces latency but increases token usage, flag cost_delta and require product sign-off vs SLA. dataset-drift monitor: if drift correlates with input attributes surface example payloads and pause rollout.
serena: who owns implementation and ETA? customers want timelines.
maya: owners: eng-runtime (harper) – rollout engine & hooks; eng-platform (eli) – metrics/alerts; product (maya/serena) – runbook + opt-in flow. ETA: internal trial MVP 3w, public opt-in 7w. will open PRD today with YAML schema.
harper: I'll sketch a JSON/YAML schema prototype and pair with eli this week. sample draft below:
```
rollout:
  baseline: model:v2026-02-14
  candidate: model:v2026-03-01-q4
  schedule:
    - duration: 24h
      percent: 2
    - duration: 48h
      percent: 10
  metrics:
    - p95_latency_ms
    - semantic_regression
  tenant_exclusions: ["tenant-821", "tenant-001"]
  auto_rollback: true
```
maya: next steps: @harper + @eli to prototype, @serena + me to finalize runbook Thu. tagging owners. :thumbsup:
